exposure: Enzyme replacement therapy (ERT) with vestronidase alfa
outcome: decreased and stabilized urinary glycosaminoglycan (GAG) levels
cohort: The study describes the first Taiwanese patient diagnosed with Mucopolysaccharidosis type VII (MPS VII) at age 4, who initially presented with hydrops fetalis and developmental delay, and started enzyme replacement therapy at age 6.
finding: Long-term enzyme replacement therapy (ERT) with vestronidase alfa demonstrated effectiveness and safety in improving respiratory function, physical performance, and growth, and stabilizing urinary glycosaminoglycan (GAG) levels in the first Taiwanese case of MPS VII.
